hook.say: Guess all six? The last one is tough.
hook.text_vi: Cá là bạn không đúng cả 6

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score.
outro.cta_vi: Bình luận điểm của bạn · Phần 2 sắp ra

words.trick: 火 fire + 车 vehicle = fire-cart
words.trick_vi: 火 lửa + 车 xe = xe lửa
words.scene: A red high-speed train gliding past a quiet green valley on a sunny morning, low side angle, real photo.
words.motion: the train glides steadily left to right through the valley; the camera slowly tracks with it

words.trick: 酒 wine + 店 shop = where guests stay
words.trick_vi: 酒 rượu + 店 tiệm = nơi khách ở
words.scene: A warm boutique hotel entrance at dusk, glowing windows, polished stone steps, real photo.
words.motion: warm lights flicker on, a few guests walk in softly; slow push-in toward the entrance

words.trick: 机 machine + 场 field = plane field
words.trick_vi: 机 máy + 场 bãi = bãi máy bay
words.scene: A bright modern airport terminal with a plane taking off behind tall glass windows, real photo.
words.motion: a plane lifts off and climbs across the sky behind the glass; slow tilt up following it

words.trick: 护 protect + 照 photo = your protected photo ID
words.trick_vi: 护 bảo vệ + 照 ảnh = ảnh được bảo hộ
words.scene: A hand holding a dark red passport with no readable text in front of a sunny airport window, shallow depth of field, real photo.
words.motion: the hand slowly turns the passport a little toward the light; gentle slow push-in

words.trick: 行 travel + 李 things = what travels with you
words.trick_vi: 行 đi + 李 đồ = đồ mang theo
words.scene: A burgundy suitcase standing alone on a sunlit train platform, real photo.
words.motion: a train slides into the platform behind the suitcase; the camera slowly circles the suitcase

words.trick: 地 ground + 铁 iron = iron under the ground
words.trick_vi: 地 đất + 铁 sắt = sắt dưới lòng đất
words.scene: A clean subway train arriving at a bright underground station, motion blur on the cars, real photo.
words.motion: the subway train rolls smoothly into the station and stops, doors slide open; the camera stays locked on a tripod, no pillars pass in front
